summary.en: Run is pressed and spins, then its own outline floods the frame into the live console (the same card in the other material): status, body, then the claim; the console retracts into the button.
summary.zh: 运行按钮按下转圈，随后它自己的轮廓淹没整个画面，变成实时控制台（同一张卡换成另一种材质）：状态、响应体，然后是主张；控制台再收回按钮里。

fits: The climax of a developer film: the thing actually runs; one claim in a pause.
notFor: Films without a button to press; claims longer than five words.

intent.en: The product is seen actually running: the button floods the frame into its live result and the claim lands in that moment.
intent.zh: 看见产品真的在跑：按钮淹没画面变成实时结果，主张就落在那一刻。

content.en: A claim (≤ 28 chars / 14 字), the card it starts from (title, tabs, Run), the product's call and two body lines.
content.zh: 一句主张（≤ 28 字符 / 14 字），起始卡片（标题、标签页、运行按钮），产品调用和两行响应体。

fits.zh: 开发者片的高潮：东西真的跑起来；一句主张在停顿里读。

notFor.zh: 没有按钮可按的片；超过五个词的主张。

en: Put the flood on a bar line (`pre` = beats to the next bar); off the bar it reads as a glitch.
zh: 淹没要落在小节线上（`pre` 为距下一小节的拍数）；不在小节上像故障。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
